audit: independent reconstruction from frozen artifacts (Mandate C section 12)
verdict: UNVERIFIABLE (model-level forward pass not re-executed in this read-only audit); data-level reconstruction VERIFIED byte-exact

data_level_reconstruction.method: Re-read the 10 frozen per-seed test_predictions.csv (variable_index==4), averaged y_pred_physical over seeds per (target_date, lead_weeks), took the lead_weeks==1 slice, and compared to final_test_curve_source_data/fig_test_nlinear_L{24,60}.csv.

model_level_reconstruction.reason: Would require re-running a forward pass from the frozen compact checkpoint (compact.safetensors). The compact checkpoint lives in an external durable screening root (not under results/) and re-executing inference exceeds the read-only, no-rerun-Test mandate of this audit.
model_level_reconstruction.note: The checkpoint was already restored under strict load (missing=0, unexpected=0) at Test time; this plus the byte-exact data-level reconstruction covers the identity/substitution concern. A full model forward re-run can be performed on a compute node if independent numeric confirmation is additionally required.
